dedupe_keys.name: national scale crop type maps for germany from sentinel 1 sentinel 2 and landsat 2017 2019

description: These maps classify German agricultural land into 24 crop and grassland classes for 2017, 2018 and 2019. The Zenodo record says dense Sentinel-2 and Landsat time series were combined with monthly Sentinel-1 backscatter and environmental data in a random forest per year, processed with the FORCE software, giving area-adjusted overall accuracies of 80, 79 and 78 percent, applied to agricultural land in ATKIS DLM 2018 and delivered as GeoTIFF files with a QGIS legend. It was published in August 2021 by researchers at the Thünen Institute, Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin and the Leibniz Centre for Agricultural Landscape Research. The Zenodo record is restricted, so files must be requested, and its licence and any fee are not stated on the page read. Coverage is Germany. Caveats: permanent crops outside ATKIS labels are merged into other classes, and accuracy varies by class. For simulation it gives field-scale crop type maps to model crop exposure to drought, hail and flood in Germany. Related catalogue records include the national crop and land cover map of Germany for 2016 and the probabilistic crop type maps for the EU.
